Adding 263 days to 1288-11-08.

1288 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply though calendar not adopted then, but we follow Gregorian arithmetic as instructed).

From 1288-11-08:
Days remaining in November: 30 – 8 = 22 days → 22 days used.
Days left in 1288 after Nov 8: 22 (Nov) + 31 (Dec) = 53 days.
263 – 53 = 210 days into 1289.

1289 is not a leap year (1289 % 4 = 1).
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31.
Sum: 31 + 28 = 59, +31 = 90, +30 = 120, +31 = 151, +30 = 181, +31 = 212 days by end of July.
We need 210 days → up to end of June: 181 days, need 29 more days into July.
July 1 + 29 days = July 30.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1289-07-30
